questions.question: Select the most appropriate homonym to fill in the blank. The hunter dogs followed the hyena’s ________.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate homonym to fill in the blank.

The hunter dogs followed the hyena’s ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "scent."

Key Points

  • Homonym is a word that is spelt and pronounced like another word but that has a different meaning.
    • Example: ‘Bank’ [river bank] and ‘bank’ [place where money is kept] are homonyms.
  • Now, let us understand the meaning of the given options:
    • "Sense" means common sense or good judgment.
    • "Scent" means an odor or trail, whereas "sense" means a feeling or perception.
    • "Cense" means to burn incense, which is not relevant to the context of the sentence.
    • "Cents" refers to a unit of currency, which does not make sense in the context of the sentence.
  • In the given sentence, the word "scent" will fit the best.
  • The correct sentence will be: The hunter dogs followed the hyena’s scent.

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

Hinglish

  • "Sense" का मतलब होता है सामान्य बुद्धि या अच्छी निर्णय क्षमता। इसका मतलब है कि किसी व्यक्ति की क्षमता की सही और गलत में अंतर करने के लिए।
  • "Scent" का मतलब होता है एक सुगंध या ट्रेल (मार्ग), जबकि "sense" का मतलब होता है एक भावना या अनुभूति।
  • "Cense" का मतलब होता है अगरबत्ती (इन्सेंस) जलाकर सुगंधित करना, यह संदर्भ में उचित नहीं है।
  • "Cents" मुद्रा इकाई की संदर्भ देते हैं, जो संदर्भ में उचित नहीं है।

questions.question: Select the most appropriate homonym to fill in the blank. Please __________ more sugar to the juice so that it becomes sweeter.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate homonym to fill in the blank. 

Please __________ more sugar to the juice so that it becomes sweeter.
questions.solution:
The correct option is: add.

Key Points

  • "Add" means to join something to something else so as to increase the size, number, or amount, which is what is intended in the sentence. (जोड़ना)
    • Example: Please add more sugar to the recipe to enhance the flavour.

Thus, the completed sentence is: "Please add more sugar to the juice so that it becomes sweeter."

Additional Information

  • "Aide" is a person who helps another person, especially a political leader or a superior. (अंगरक्षक)
    • ​Example: The senator's aide answered the phone.
  • "Ad" is an abbreviation for advertisement. (विज्ञापन)
    • ​Example: She saw an interesting ad in the newspaper.
  • "Aid" means to provide support, help, or assistance. (सहायता)
    • Example: She provided aid to the injured hiker.

questions.question: Direction: Select the nearest homonym of the given word. Accept
questions.questionHtml:
Direction: Select the nearest homonym of the given word.

Accept
questions.solution:
The reason for selecting the nearest homonym for "Accept" as "Except" is based on the similarity in pronunciation and spelling.
"Accept" means to receive or agree to something. Example: She was quick to accept the job offer, excited about the new opportunities it would bring. "Except" is used to exclude or leave out something. Example: Everyone attended the meeting except for Sarah, who had a prior commitment.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate homophone to fill in the blank. He has the _______ to express his thoughts.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

Additional Information

questions.question: Select the most appropriate homophone to fill in the blank. He ______ his bike as fast as he could to reach home.

Key Points

  • Rote: Mechanical or habitual repetition of something to be learned (रटकर याद करना)

questions.question: Select the most appropriate homophone to fill in the blank. The dog took a __________ during his walk and lifted his __________ to indicate that he was tired.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate homophone to fill in the blank.

The dog took a __________ during his walk and lifted his __________ to indicate that he was tired.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: pause; paws

Key Points

  • Homophones are words that sound the same but have different meanings and often different spellings.
  • In the first context, "pause" is used to describe a momentary stop or break in the dog's activity. (एक क्षणिक रुकना या विराम)
  • It implies that the dog briefly halted or interrupted its walk, possibly to rest or take a break.
  • In the second part, "paws" refers to the dog's feet. (पंजा, पाँव)
  • The sentence suggests that the dog lifted its paws as a sign of fatigue or weariness, indicating that it needed a break or rest from walking.
  • This sentence cleverly uses the homophones "pause" and "paws" to create a playful and meaningful expression, describing a moment of rest for the dog during its walk.

Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.

Complete sentence: The dog took a pause during his walk and lifted his paws to indicate that he was tired.

Additional Information

  • Pours: The action of flowing or streaming, typically referring to liquids being poured from one container to another. (बरसता है)
  • Pores: Small openings or spaces, especially in the skin or a surface, through which substances can pass or be absorbed. (छिद्र)

questions.question: Select the most appropriate homophone to fill in the blank. There was a big hole in the wall which they are trying to close. It took a ___________ day for them to do the job.

Correct Sentence: There was a big hole in the wall which they are trying to close. It took a whole day for them to do the job.

questions.solution: The correct word for the first blank is "roses," and the correct word for the second blank is "rose." Key Points

  • The homonym for "flea" among the options provided is "flee."
  • "Flee" means to run away or escape from a place or situation, often due to fear or danger. It's a verb that describes the act of quickly moving away to avoid something threatening or unpleasant.
  • Let's look at the meaning of other words:
    • "Fleece" refers to the woolly coat of a sheep or the fabric made from such wool.
    • "Flew" is the past tense of the verb "fly," which means to move through the air using wings or to travel quickly.
    • "Fly" can be a verb describing the action of moving through the air using wings or an insect, but it can also refer to a fastener on clothing or a means of travel by air.
  • In this context, "flea" refers to a small, blood-sucking insect that often infests animals or humans, and "flee" is the word that means to run away or escape.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate homonym to fill in the blank. The authorities ________ the unregistered companies.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate homonym to fill in the blank.

The authorities ________ the unregistered companies.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: seize

Key Points

  • A homonym is a word that has the same spelling or pronunciation as another word but may have a different meaning.
  • Seize means to take hold of suddenly or forcibly; to grasp, grab, or capture. (पकड़ना)
    • Example: The police officer moved quickly to seize the suspect and prevent further escape.
  • ​So, "Seize" fits in this context, indicating that the authorities are taking action against the unregistered companies.

Therefore, the correct answer is option 2.

Complete sentence: The authorities seize the unregistered companies.

Additional Information

  • Sees: The third person singular form of the verb "see," which means to perceive with the eyes. (देखना)
  • Seas: Plural form of the noun "sea," referring to large bodies of saltwater that cover much of the Earth's surface. (सागरों)
  • Cease: To stop or come to an end; the act of discontinuing or halting an activity. (रोकना)

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. My uncle‘s legal ________ is his son.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: heir

Key Points

  • An heir is a person who is legally entitled to inherit the property, wealth, or title of another person, typically a family member, upon their death. (उत्तराधिकार में पानेवाला)
    • Example: As the only son of a wealthy business magnate, Daniel was the heir to the family fortune and business empire.
  • The given sentence describes the legal relationship of the uncle's son to inherit his assets, making "heir" the correct term to use.

Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.

Complete sentence: My uncle‘s legal heir is his son.

Additional Information

  • Hair: Fine, thread-like strands that grow from the skin of mammals, particularly humans. (केश)
  • Here: In or at this place. (इस स्थान पर)
  • Hare: A fast-running, long-eared mammal, similar to a rabbit. (खरगोश)

___________ coming from the kitchen.
questions.solution:

Key Points

  • The word "They're" is a contraction for "they are", which is used to indicate that "they" (a group of people or things) are performing an action. (वे हैं)
    • Example: They're going to the market to buy groceries.
  • "They're" is used to describe the action of a group of people or things. (वे हैं)
    • Example: They're working on the project together.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • They (वे): Used to refer to two or more people or things previously mentioned or easily identified.
    • Example: They are planning to visit the museum this weekend.
  • There (वहाँ): Used to indicate a place or position.
    • Example: There is a cat sitting on the roof.
  • Their (उनका): Possessive form of 'they', used to indicate that something belongs to or is associated with the people or things previously mentioned.
    • Example: Their house is located on the hilltop.
